# Historical real-match reference (tests only)

Two Liga Portugal 2024–2025 fixtures, checked against the dated **2024–25 FC Porto season** reference on 13 October 2026 through a normal read-only request from GitHub Actions:

- FC Porto – Braga, 6 October 2024, 18:00 WEST (UTC+01:00), **2–1**.
- Benfica – FC Porto, 10 November 2024, 20:45 WET (UTC+00:00), **4–1**.

Source and attribution: [Wikipedia contributors, 2024–25 FC Porto season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024%E2%80%9325_FC_Porto_season#Primeira_Liga), [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Inspection evidence: GitHub Actions run `38432352204`, annotation “Licensed football sample”. The CSV transcribes dates, team names and final scores only; every unverified statistic is blank.

These fixtures are used in isolated PostgreSQL tests, never seeded or automatically uploaded into the owner's Supabase project. They are historical verification cases, not the requested 2026–2027 season and not an extraction from Flashscore.
